title: Apple Seeks Engineers for New AI Agent Project
excerpt: Apple is hiring engineers to develop an agentic AI assistant capable of browsing the web, using apps, writing code, and calling services.
body_html:
Apple is currently working on the development of its own artificial intelligence agent designed to perform various user tasks. According to a recent job listing, the company is seeking an engineer to lead the creation of this new assistant.

The planned AI agent is intended to handle multiple functions. Based on the details from the listing, its capabilities will include:

  • Browsing the web automatically
  • Working across different applications
  • Writing code
  • Calling various services

The initiative points to Apple's ongoing efforts to expand its capabilities in advanced artificial intelligence technology.
